tag_line: Research-guided road tyre physics, thermals, pressure and physical wear simulation
title: Kagoni’s Tyre Simulation
message:
[CENTER]
[B][SIZE=7]Kagoni's Tyre Simulation[/SIZE][/B]

[SIZE=4][I]A research-guided dynamic tyre simulation for BeamNG.drive adding temperature, pressure, structural behaviour, contact-patch dynamics and physical tread wear.[/I][/SIZE]

[I][COLOR=#ff8000]The current resource page has been simplified for users uninterested in the technical side and get straight to the point of how to use the app. :)
[/COLOR][/I]

[hr][/hr]
[CENTER][SIZE=5]
[COLOR=#00b359][B]An easy car should be easy for physical reasons.[/B][/COLOR]

[COLOR=#b35900][B]A difficult car should be difficult for physical reasons.[/B][/COLOR]

[B]And when the behaviour changes, the tyre should be able to tell us why.[/B]
[/SIZE][/CENTER]


[SIZE=6][B][COLOR=#ff8000]HOW TO USE[/COLOR][/B][/SIZE]

[ATTACH=full]1331677[/ATTACH]

[LIST=1]
[*]Download / subscribe, enable KTS, then add the [B]Kagoni Tyre Simulation HUD[/B] from the UI Apps menu.

[*]Spawn the vehicle or reload it with [B]Ctrl + R[/B].

[*]Click the HUD graphics to open the tyre menu.

[*]Choose [B]REALISTIC[/B] for the full model or [B]ARCADE[/B] for a more forgiving version of the same tyre simulation.

[*]Leave the tyre preset on [B]AUTO[/B] for normal use. KTS will classify the installed tyre and apply the matching construction / temperature behaviour.

[*]Use [B]PREHEAT[/B] when you want prepared tyres, detailed description below.
[*]Front / Rear PSI can be adjusted from the tyre menu.
[LIST]
[*]In normal mode, pressure changes apply immediately.
[*]In [B]RACING MODE[/B], the entered PSI is treated as the [B]cold / tune PSI[/B] for the next pit stop.
[/LIST]
[*]For a pit stop, enable [B]RACING MODE[/B], stage the tyre / compound / PSI you want, then stop the car. PIT MANAGER performs a [B]15-second tyre service[/B] and applies the staged setup.

[*]Single-click [B]WEAR[/B] to switch between physical tread wear and infinite-rubber regeneration.

[*]Double-click [B]WEAR[/B] to temporarily disable KTS until the vehicle is reloaded or changed.

[*]Triple-click anywhere on the HUD to enable Debug.
[*]Double-click the Debug HUD to open the full-screen detailed telemetry view.

[*]Very unusual / lightweight vehicles may occasionally need manual [B]Struct PSI[/B] correction in Debug if the automatic structural-pressure estimate is clearly wrong.
[/LIST]

[SIZE=5][B]PREHEAT & ADVANCED PREHEAT[/B]:[/SIZE]
[LIST]
[*][B]QUICK[/B] heats mainly the tyre's outer working layers, useful for quickly preparing a tyre without fully heat-soaking the complete tyre structure.

[*][B]SOAKED[/B] brings the tread, core, sidewalls, rim and cavity air toward the selected temperature, similar to a fully heat-soaked tyre / tyre-warmer state.

[*]For normal use, leave [B]Advanced Preheat[/B] closed. The main PREHEAT temperature applies to all four tyres.

[*]Open [B]Advanced Preheat[/B] when you want different temperatures around the car.
[LIST]
[*][B]No links[/B] — set FL / FR / RL / RR independently.

[*][B]Link Left / Right[/B] — both tyres on each axle are linked, giving separate [B]Front[/B] and [B]Rear[/B] temperatures.

[*][B]Link Front / Rear[/B] — both tyres on each side are linked, giving separate [B]Left[/B] and [B]Right[/B] temperatures.
[/LIST]
[*]Only one link direction can be active at a time.

[*]Closing the Advanced Preheat dropdown immediately returns PREHEAT to the normal global temperature target.

[*]Advanced Preheat also works with [B]RACING MODE + PIT MANAGER[/B], allowing different tyre temperatures to be staged for the next pit stop.
[/LIST]

[CENTER][SIZE=4][B][COLOR=#ff4444]IMPORTANT[/COLOR][/B]
[B][COLOR=#ff4444]ONLY ENABLE ONE VERSION OF A LUUK-BASED[/COLOR][/B]
[B][COLOR=#ff4444]TYRE MOD AT A TIME.[/COLOR][/B]
[/SIZE][/CENTER]

Older KTS builds and other mods derived from Luuk's Tyre Thermals and Wear framework can share extension paths and conflict with one another.


[hr][/hr]

[SIZE=6][B][COLOR=#00b3b3]FEATURES[/COLOR][/B][/SIZE]

[LIST]
[*][B]Live temperature-dependent physical tyre stiffness[/B] that changes the actual BeamNG tread structure, with automatic precompression compensation.

[*]Separate construction / temperature calibration for [B]Standard / Road, Sport / Performance Road, Semi-Slick / Sport Plus 2R, Race Slick, Drift and Rally[/B] tyre families.

[*]Wheel-local [B]slip, saturation, contact-patch and friction-work[/B] behaviour for braking, acceleration, cornering and combined slip.

[*]Microscopic [B]flash temperature[/B], fast road-facing surface temperature and slower tread / carcass heat soak.

[*][B]12 through-depth tread thermal cells[/B] across Outer / Middle / Inner zones.

[*]Independent [B]core, inner sidewall, outer sidewall, cavity-air and rim[/B] thermal states.

[*]Rotating circumferential [B]HOTSPOTS and COLDSPOTS[/B] with localized heat / cooling memory through multiple tread depths.

[*]Live tyre pressure that preserves BeamNG's native pressure / volume behaviour while adding cavity-air thermal pressure change.

[*][B]No KTS upper PSI cap[/B] — high-pressure truck / bus tyres are no longer clipped by passenger-car pressure limits inside KTS.

[*]Physical [B]tread-depth wear[/B] with independent Outer / Middle / Inner condition, uneven wear and localized tread scars.

[*]Wear-dependent [B]rubber mass, groove depth, groove taper, cooling, dry-grip behaviour and physical stiffness[/B].

[*]Tyre-family-dependent dry grip versus wear, so worn road tyres do not lose dry grip like an exhausted racing slick.

[*]Final road-family temperature calibration plus [B]Cup 2 R-style Sport Plus 2R / Semi-Slick[/B] warm-up and overheat behaviour.

[*][B]QUICK / SOAKED PREHEAT[/B], editable Front / Rear PSI and [B]RACING MODE + PIT MANAGER[/B].

[*][B]REALISTIC[/B] and [B]ARCADE[/B] modes using the same modern physical tyre framework.

[*]Multi-rate thermal / wear updates, cached slow-changing values and reduced Debug overhead for better performance.

[*]Detailed HUD and full-screen Debug telemetry for temperature, pressure, tread depth, wear, load distribution and structural state.
[/LIST]


[SIZE=5][B]HUD[/B]

[ATTACH=full]1331656[/ATTACH][ATTACH=full]1331657[/ATTACH][ATTACH=full]1331658[/ATTACH][ATTACH=full]1331659[/ATTACH][/SIZE]

The HUD shows the live tyre state at a glance:

[LIST]
[*]remaining tyre condition and physical tread depth
[*]live PSI
[*]Outer / Middle / Inner tread condition
[*]surface / tread / core / sidewall / cavity thermal state
[*]localized temperature / wear behaviour
[*]live structural / load information
[/LIST]


[SIZE=5][B]REALISTIC[/B][/SIZE]

The full research-guided KTS tyre model and its intended handling calibration.


[SIZE=5][B]ARCADE[/B][/SIZE]

A more forgiving version of the same modern tyre model, with reduced temperature-related grip / stiffness severity.


[hr][/hr]

[SIZE=6][B][COLOR=#ff8000]CURRENT LIMITATIONS[/COLOR][/B][/SIZE]

KTS is an experimental [B]reduced-order tyre simulation[/B] built on top of BeamNG's existing vehicle physics. It is not a commercial finite-element tyre model.

[LIST]
[*]Exact construction still has to be inferred from the geometry and structural information exposed by BeamNG / JBeam.

[*]Some unusual third-party tyres, very small tyres and heavily modified pressure-wheel structures can produce inaccurate structural estimates.

[*]Manufacturer compound data is usually proprietary, so many curves are research-guided normalized calibrations rather than reproductions of a specific commercial tyre.

[*]Actual rim width / tyre stretch is not yet independently modeled, so extreme stretched or pinched fitments may be estimated incorrectly.

[*]Circumferential heat / wear is represented with a [B]sparse reduced-order rotating state[/B], not a full three-dimensional per-millimetre tyre mesh.

[*]Detailed sidewall abrasion and sidewall structural damage are not yet simulated.

[*]Full aquaplaning / water-film dynamics are not yet implemented.

[*]Loose-surface behaviour still relies heavily on BeamNG's native ground physics underneath KTS's Rally thermal / wear model, so unusual custom materials can require fallback classification.

[*]Some specialist areas — including slick wear-rate refinement, longitudinal B-slip calibration, drift-specific calibration and very small / kart tyres — are still being developed further.

[*]Very unusual lightweight vehicles may still need manual structural-pressure correction.

[*]Future BeamNG tyre-physics changes may require KTS compatibility updates.
[/LIST]

[hr][/hr]

[SIZE=6][B][COLOR=#00b3b3]CHANGELOGS[/COLOR][/B][/SIZE]

[SIZE=5][B]v1.5.0 PUBLIC[/B][/SIZE]

[LIST]
[*]Added [B]live temperature-dependent physical tread stiffness[/B] with automatic precompression compensation.

[*]Rebuilt the tyre thermal network around separate tread, core, sidewall, cavity-air and rim states.

[*]Moved heating / wear toward more wheel-local slip, load, force and BeamNG-native friction-work behaviour.

[*]Expanded circumferential state with rotating [B]HOTSPOTS and COLDSPOTS[/B] through multiple tread depths.

[*]Changed wear-related behaviour to use [B]physical tread depth[/B], including wear-dependent rubber mass, grooves, cooling and stiffness.

[*]Recalibrated dry grip versus tread wear so road tyres retain more realistic dry grip while race tyres can lose more performance near end-of-life.

[*]Finalized Standard / Sport road-temperature behaviour and [B]Cup 2 R-style Sport Plus 2R / Semi-Slick[/B] warm-up / overheat calibration.

[*]Improved destructive wear energy accounting so removed rubber consumes mechanical energy instead of creating an artificial heat / wear feedback loop.

[*]Unified normal and Race Mode [B]PREHEAT[/B] behaviour.

[*]Race Mode PSI is now [B]cold / tune PSI[/B]: the fresh tyre is set cold, PSI is applied, then QUICK / SOAKED preheat raises hot pressure naturally.

[*]Removed all KTS upper PSI caps, including the old hidden structural-pressure limits.

[*]Added / refined [B]RACING MODE + PIT MANAGER[/B] staged tyre / compound / PSI service.

[*]Continued steering / tyre-feel calibration using real-car feedback from [B]@tabz96 / @t4bzgregory[/B] and later direct-drive FFB refinement with [URL='https://www.beamng.com/members/comm-ander.104746/'][B]comm-ander[/B][/URL] using a Simucube 2 Pro.

[*]Built independent Assetto Corsa and expanded BeamNG development telemetry for cross-simulator / full-lap validation.

[*]Optimized the simulation with multi-rate updates, cached slow-changing values and reduced Debug overhead.

[*]Removed the development recorder / automated calibration tools from the public package.

[*]Cleaned the HUD, wheel ordering, load indicator, public metadata and source package while retaining the research-reference comments used by code divers.
[/LIST]

[SIZE=5][B]v1.5.0 Preview 1[/B][/SIZE]

[LIST]
[*]Added [B]live temperature-dependent physical tread stiffness[/B], allowing KTS to modify the actual BeamNG tyre structure as temperature changes.

[*]Added automatic [B]tread-precompression compensation[/B] so stiffness changes do not unnecessarily alter tyre shape or loaded radius.

[*]Added separate [B]Standard, Sport / Performance Road and Semi-Slick[/B] construction and temperature calibration.

[*]Fixed physical stiffness and [B]B100 / cornering-stiffness[/B] double-counting so the same temperature effect is not applied twice.

[*]Rebuilt the tyre thermal network with separate [B]core, inner sidewall, outer sidewall, cavity-air and rim[/B] temperatures.

[*]Added geometry-dependent sidewall rolling heat, conduction and external cooling.

[*]Changed thermal and wear calculations to use [B]true per-wheel angular velocity[/B].

[*]Replaced whole-car lateral-G heating with more accurate [B]wheel-local slip-power heating[/B].

[*]Recalibrated normal-driving wear versus wheelspin, lockups and destructive sliding.

[*]Added rotating [B]circumferential heat and localized tread-wear scars[/B].

[*]Added localized temperature influence on physical tread stiffness and wear vulnerability.

[*]Reworked tyre pressure so KTS adds thermal pressure changes while preserving BeamNG’s native pressure / volume behaviour.

[*]Added editable [B]Front / Rear live PSI[/B] controls.

[*]Added [B]RACING MODE and PIT MANAGER[/B] with staged tyre / compound / PSI selection and a 15-second tyre service.


[*]Updated Arcade mode to use the modern tyre model with reduced temperature penalties instead of a separate legacy handling path.

[*]Reorganized the HUD and tuning interface and removed obsolete / duplicated controls.

[*]Built a new automated calibration toolchain with a [B]self-growing database of 200+ observed BeamNG tyre IDs[/B].

[*]Between v1.4 and the v1.5.0 preview, development went through [B]113 confirmed internal builds[/B], including more than [B]10 hours of controlled in-game data collection and calibration testing[/B] across multiple vehicles, tyre sizes and constructions.

[*]Added real-world tyre and steering-wheel feedback from [B]@tabz96 / @t4bzgregory[/B] and friends as an additional calibration reference.
[/LIST]


[SIZE=5][B]v1.4[/B][/SIZE]

[LIST]
[*]Added dedicated [B]Rally Asphalt[/B] and [B]Rally Gravel[/B] tyre families with Super Soft / Soft / Medium / Hard compounds.

[*]Added a new [B]Road ↔ Dirt rally physics system[/B], allowing the same physical tyre state to transition continuously between pavement, gravel, dirt, sand and mud.

[*]Added terrain-specific rally tyre heat generation and temperature behaviour while preserving BeamNG's native loose-surface ground physics.

[*]Added physical rally [B]tread-block height wear[/B] and signed directional [B]X+ / X− / Y+ / Y− block-edge wear[/B].

[*]Added separate block-height and active-edge condition effects so rally tyres can lose different types of loose-surface performance depending on how they are driven.

[*]Added open-tread thermal behaviour for Rally Gravel tyres, including reduced tread rubber mass, reduced conduction area and additional groove-air cooling.

[*]Added wear-dependent groove depth and wheelspin-sensitive forced airflow through gravel tread grooves.

[*]Improved Rally AUTO tyre detection for vehicles using nested tyre / pressure-wheel part structures.

[*]Improved terrain detection and mixed-surface handling, including fallback classification for custom-map ground materials.

[*]Fixed premature [B]downward grip correction before calculated tyre saturation[/B]. Downward correction now remains blocked until the model reaches its calculated peak.

[*]Prevented Rally road and dirt tyre corrections from operating simultaneously or double-counting tyre-condition losses.

[*]Recalibrated Rally Gravel dry-road behaviour while keeping loose-surface grip limited by BeamNG's native terrain physics.

[*]Normalized Rally compound-local peak multipliers so compound differences now come primarily from temperature, stiffness, B100, wear and overheat behaviour rather than additional static grip multipliers.

[*]Expanded rally, contact, thermal, wear and structural telemetry for development and calibration.

[*]Added a transparent fullscreen four-wheel diagnostic HUD with detailed per-tyre thermal, grip, pressure, wear and rally-surface information.

[*]Added HUD double/triple-click Debug controls without interfering with the existing Wear button behaviour.
[/LIST]


[SIZE=5][B]v1.3[/B][/SIZE]

[LIST]
[*]Fixed the post-B100 minimum grip floor that could artificially add grip back during large slides.

[*]Added global model-owned full-slip behaviour for Standard, Sport, Race and Drift tyres.

[*]Improved cold Sport/UHP grip, stiffness and B100 behaviour.

[*]Fixed artificial high-angle self-stabilisation during large slides.

[*]Worn tyres now generate less tread-dependent rolling and deformation heat.

[*]Recalibrated Standard, Sport and Race Soft / Medium / Hard wear behaviour.

[*]Added improved crown/belt support for Sport and Race tyres under high load.

[*]Retains the v1.2 race-tyre core-temperature, rolling-heat and duplicate torque-heater fixes.

[*]Retains the dynamic wear-temperature model, PREHEAT pressure system and Advanced tuning cleanup.
[/LIST]

[SIZE=5][B]v1.2[/B][/SIZE]

[LIST]
[*]Fixed excessive GT3/GT4 race tyre core overheating.

[*]Improved rolling-hysteresis heat distribution between tread and core.

[*]Removed the legacy duplicate torque/braking tyre heater.

[*]Added dynamic slip-dependent wear-temperature weighting.

[*]Improved separation between near-peak driving and heavy-sliding wear.

[*]Further calibrated race-tyre post-peak behaviour using GT4 reference testing.

[*]PREHEAT now calculates and applies hot cavity-air, rim-temperature and operating-pressure states.

[*]Added per-tyre cold → hot-target → overpressure PSI colour indication.

[*]Advanced tuning values are now normalized to [B]100% = native[/B].

[*]Removed legacy duplicate tuning multipliers and obsolete Advanced controls.

[*]General code cleanup and additional thermal / pressure telemetry improvements.
[/LIST]

[SIZE=5][B]v1.1[/B][/SIZE]

[LIST]
[*]Fixed excessive brake heat being double-counted into the tyre core.

[*]Brake heat now propagates through the rim / cavity-air / carcass thermal network instead of directly heating the core.

[*]Recalibrated Sport / semi-slick wear.

[*]Reaching B100 no longer immediately applies full abrasion wear; wear progressively increases with contact-patch saturation and actual sliding velocity.

[*]Target Sport wear recalibrated toward approximately 2–4% for a clean aggressive lap and 3–5% when regularly driving around peak grip.

[*]Added improved smooth-gradient PREHEAT behaviour.

[*]No changes to the Sport grip-handling calibration.
[/LIST]

[SIZE=5][B]BeamNG.drive[/B][/SIZE]

All underlying vehicle, node/beam, wheel, contact and driving physics are provided by [B]BeamNG.drive[/B].

Kagoni Tyre Simulation is an independent community modification and is not affiliated with or endorsed by BeamNG GmbH.

[SIZE=5][B]Research Authors & Facilities[/B][/SIZE]

KTS has been developed with the help of publicly available tyre, rubber, friction, thermal, structural and wear research produced by researchers, universities, laboratories and testing organisations around the world.

[B]The complete research bibliography, individual source links and acknowledgements are documented in the KTS Technical Documentation & Research thread.[/B]

[hr][/hr]

[CENTER][SIZE=3]
Kagoni Tyre Simulation is intended for simulation, entertainment and experimentation.

It must not be used for real vehicle engineering, motorsport safety decisions, real-world tyre setup recommendations or vehicle safety analysis.

If you find a bug, an unusual tyre, a compatibility problem or something that simply does not make physical sense, feedback is always appreciated. :)

[/SIZE][/CENTER]
